name: Grand Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a haunted grand piano with its face above the keys, a pink swirl under the lid and a magenta plasma hand
entry: It plays an empty concert hall by itself. Listeners say its music shows them memories they had forgotten.
how: Use a Phantom Piano Key on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Psychic in this form.
